Name: Custom Spouse Patio Wizard
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[b]Notice: this mod is now obsolete, please use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10889]Custom Spouse Patio Redux[/url]﻿ instead.[/b]


So, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6630]Custom Spouse Patio[/url] was more popular than I expected, which is great! But a lot of people couldn't make it work because of the need to know a bit of json, etc. So, hopefully this tool will make the process of adding custom spouse patios easier.

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6630]Custom Spouse Patio[/url]﻿ v.0.7.0+ to work.

To use, just go to your farm, hover the cursor over a tile, and press the hotkey button (default [b]F8[/b]). The menu will pop up and give you several options. Just follow the basic interface and you should see the changes immediately.


[b][size=4]Current Functionality[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]Add new spouse area at chosen cursor tile
[*]Move existing spouse area to the chosen cursor tile or in a specific direction
[*]Remove existing spouse area
[*]List existing spouse areas
[*]Reload existing spouse areas
[/list]

[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Only accessible if you have a spouse and are on the farm.
[*]Allows you to choose spouse area tiles of any vanilla NPC. Be aware that not all characters look good with someone else's spouse area! See [url=https://stardewcommunitywiki.com/Marriage#Spouse_Outside_Area]here[/url]﻿ for what default spouse areas look like.
[*]Does not allow you to remove spouse areas from external content packs provided by other mods.
[*]Does allow you to move spouse areas provided by external content packs - this creates an internal copy that overrides the content pack spouse area.
[*]Does not allow you to create spouse areas with custom tilesheets; see the Custom Spouse Patio mod documentation for how to do that.
[*]If you remove all spouse patios, CSP will show your (main) spouse's default patio at the default location (provided they have one).
[*]Spouse patios added with this mod are located in a file called [b]outdoor-areas.json[/b] in the Custom Spouse Patio mod's folder. For manual modification, just edit that file with notepad (Notepad++ recommended). If you corrupt that file, just delete it and start over with the wizard.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Technical:[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6630]Custom Spouse Patio[/url]﻿, doesn't use Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
